verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents automated scans run as jobs inside your CI provider and triggered by events such as pushes and pull/merge requests. It also offers Managed Scans for bulk onboarding without CI changes. However, no evidence shows a native time-based or recurring scheduler; any recurring cadence would depend on the external CI system. Missing for 10: a native scheduled or cron-style recurring scan capability, documentation of recurring cadence for Managed Scans, and any hands-on corroboration of scheduled workflows.
